papers.title: Influence of defects on mechanical properties of Ti–6Al–4V components produced by selective laser melting and electron beam melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: J.B. Speed School of Engineering, University of Louisville, Louisville, KY, United States

corresponding_authors.name: Haijun Gong
corresponding_authors.affiliation: J.B. Speed School of Engineering, University of Louisville, Louisville, KY, United States

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了增材制造钛合金的缺陷对力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构设计或应力遮挡问题，与生物医学植入物方向的直接关联度有限。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design for stress shielding mitigation, nor does it include biomedical context such as osseointegration or implant-specific fatigue testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究缺陷对激光和电子束熔融钛合金力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM和EBM制备试样，分析缺陷类型及分布。
summary_zh.result: 缺陷显著降低材料的静强度和疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 采用拉伸和疲劳实验验证结果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how manufacturing defects influence the mechanical performance of Ti-6Al-4V components fabricated by selective laser melting and electron beam melting.
summary_en.method: Specimens were produced via SLM and EBM, and defect characteristics were analyzed and correlated with mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Defects such as porosity and lack-of-fusion significantly reduce both static strength and fatigue life of the material.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile and fatigue experiments was conducted to validate the findings.

papers.title: Fabrication of Fe-based bulk metallic glass by selective laser melting: A parameter study
papers.first_author_affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, Helmholtzstr. 20, D-01069 Dresden, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Hyo Yun Jung
corresponding_authors.affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, Helmholtzstr. 20, D-01069 Dresden, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Fe基金属玻璃的选区激光熔化工艺，未涉及生物医学植入物相关的多孔结构、应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合等问题。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical application, no porous structure, no mechanical testing for implants, no stress shielding or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Fe基金属玻璃选区激光熔化工艺参数的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数制备样品并表征
summary_zh.result: 确定了获得高致密度样品的工艺窗口
summary_zh.validation: X射线衍射和密度测量进行表征

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting process parameters on the fabrication of Fe-based bulk metallic glass.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated with varying laser power and scanning speed, and characterized for density and structure.
summary_en.result: Optimized parameters were identified for achieving high densification.
summary_en.validation: Density measurements and X-ray diffraction were used to characterize the as-built samples.
